title: AgentWikis Corpus Architecture, Trust Semantics & Data Governance

claims.assertion: Every wiki declares covers, notCovered, and currentAs to prevent hallucinations and establish definitive knowledge boundaries.
claims.evidence_quote: scope — every wiki declares covers / notCovered / currentAs (freshness is derived from the wiki itself, never hand-typed). If your question is out of scope, use the web instead.

claims.assertion: Search returns a calibrated confident flag that achieves ~94% correct abstention when coverage is missing.
claims.evidence_quote: confident — MCP search returns a calibrated flag; when false, the wiki likely lacks the answer (measured ~94% correct abstention). Fall back to web search rather than trusting a weak match.

claims.assertion: The corpus is consumable offline as single full-text (llms-full.txt) or via raw markdown endpoints with ETag/Last-Modified caching.
claims.evidence_quote: llms-full.txt — the entire corpus in one fetch ... Every page is served as its exact on-disk Markdown — YAML frontmatter included

claims.assertion: AgentWikis exposes four read-only MCP tools: list_wikis, open_wiki, search, and read_document.
claims.evidence_quote: four read-only tools shaped for an agent's loop: list_wikis (discover + scope), open_wiki (orient: metadata + document map), search (ranked pages + a calibrated confident flag), read_document (full page or a single section, with provenance).
